_readme: An example patch for the admin's 'Mama's knowledge base' slipstream page.
These are problems that are ALREADY SOLVED. When one of them matches what
she asks, /mama answers straight from this file - instantly, in your words,
without waking the desktop and without asking a model anything.
THE ONE FIELD TO UNDERSTAND: "direct"
true   this answer is good enough to send as-is. It becomes the reply.
absent this article is only shown to the model as a fix to follow.
It is opt-in on purpose. An article written in a hurry gets the safe
behaviour until you have read it back and decided it is right. Set it to
true once you would be happy for her to read it with nobody checking.
SYMPTOMS IS THE FIELD THAT MAKES IT WORK. Write the phrases SHE would use,
not the ones a technician would. 'it says offline' and 'nothing comes out
of the printer' both belong on the printer article; 'print spooler service'
does not, because she will never say it. Matching is word overlap against
these lines - no model, no embedding, so it works while the GPU is asleep.
If an article is not matching, the fix is almost always to add the sentence
she actually typed to its symptoms. /mama's admin has a 'Known fixes' page
with a Try-a-question box that shows you the score for exactly this.
STEPS are numbered on screen and she follows them with a finger, so one
action per step and no branching. Keep 'if that did not work' for the end.
Keys starting with _ are ignored by everything that reads this file.

add.title: Printer says offline but it is switched on
symptoms: nothing comes out of the printer
it says the printer is not connected
add.answer: This is nearly always the printer having quietly dropped off the Wi-Fi. It is not anything you did, and it does not mean the printer is broken.
steps: Switch the printer off at the button on the front, and wait while you count slowly to ten.
Switch it back on, and wait until the lights stop moving about.
Try printing the same thing again.
add.note: If it happens most weeks, tell me - the printer is probably too far from the router and that is fixable.

add.title: Tablet will not join the Wi-Fi
symptoms: the tablet will not join the wifi
add.answer: Nine times out of ten the tablet is holding on to a connection that has already gone. Turning the Wi-Fi off and on makes it look again.
steps: Turn the switch at the top off, count to five, and turn it back on.
Wait for the network name to appear in the list, and tap it.
If it asks for the password, it is on the sticker on the underside of the internet box.
